sub_sector.value: residential roofing shingles; building insulation; glass fiber composites

manufacturing_type.detail: Continuous process production of shingles, glass fiber insulation, glass veils and composites.

production_model.detail: Branded shingles and insulation made to stock; nonwoven veils tailor-made per customer request.

product_complexity.detail: Branded, patented-technology building products and differentiated glass-based materials.

production_role.detail: Sells branded finished roofing, insulation and doors; also supplies veils and composites to other manufacturers.

end_market_exposure.detail: Residential and commercial construction and re-roofing; nonwovens and composites for flooring, interiors, industrial uses.
